prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1110; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on tape yet, but you can use the claim file reference.
Q: That works. Can you tell me where and roughly when the collision happened?
A: It was on the frontage road in Katy, Texas, on a weekday afternoon, around rush hour. Traffic was slow and stop and go.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was changing lanes to the right to get over for my exit. I checked my mirror and saw nothing, so I signaled and started moving over.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not until it hit my rear passenger side. It came up in the blind spot, I think. It was a dark sedan, and it scraped along my door and clipped my back bumper.
Q: Were you able to stop, or did you keep moving?
A: I pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver kept going for a second and then stopped.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: Not great. I've had a headache that won't go away, I get dizzy when I look at screens too long, and I'm sensitive to light. The urgent care doctor said it looks like a concussion.
Q: Did you hit your head during the collision?
A: I think so. My head bounced off the window frame when the car jerked. I didn't black out, but I felt foggy for a while afterward.
Q: Have you seen a physician since the accident?
A: Yes, I'm following up with a neurologist and I'm taking time off work until they clear me.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you want to add?
A: Only that I was following the rules and I want my car and my medical care taken care of properly.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
